English: Mud Brick Storehouse
A simple, hastily-constructed storehouse of sun-dried mud bricks. Used for basic grain storage, offering minimal protection.
Wattle Granary
A wattle-and-daub granary, allowing for improved airflow and better preservation of sacred grain stores.
Sunken Grain Pit
Ingeniously dug below ground, these pits offer both security and improved preservation for the temples stores.
Stone Granary Shed
A small granary made of rough stone, improving pest resistance and safeguarding religious tithes.
Raised Granary
A wooden structure elevated on stone piers, protecting sacred grain from floods and vermin.
Ventilated Storehouse
A sophisticated wooden and stone building with improved airflow and religious inscriptions, preserving grain and sanctifying the store.
Large Grain Chamber
A substantial stone chamber, featuring decorated alcoves and guarded access, supporting religious festivals and temple feasts.
Fortified Granary
A heavily-defended stone granary with reinforced doors and small garrison, protecting both spiritual and material wealth.
Farmlands Grain Tower
A tall stone tower visible for miles, containing vast stores of grain and serving as a symbol of spiritual and agricultural prosperity.
Farmlands Granary Complex
A sprawling, multi-structure granary complex, containing vaults, chapels, and learning chambers dedicated to agricultural and spiritual wisdom.
